title: Generalized Riemann Hypothesis for Dirichlet L-functions (grh-lean, compact edition)
description: Dirichlet nonvanishing for every positive modulus and every character when Re(s) > 1/2, excluding only the principal pole: GRH for Dirichlet L-functions. The same development also proves the Riemann Hypothesis in Mathlib's form (Candidate/GRH.lean, riemannHypothesis). The proof is Levent Alpöge's, with Claude (https://alpo.ge/remark.pdf); this is the compact edition of the shorter rewriting by Anthropic and Claude published at https://github.com/lsernau/grh-lean (commit 72fead102f663d5c7a407964a13dc0cf9d977207, 2026-11-25, directory grh-compact). It uses only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound, and does not import the OpenAI baseline. Changes for the tracker: modules re-rooted under Candidate (upstream Main renamed GRH), the lakefile leanOptions moved into each file, the Candidate.bound wrapper added, and the proof backported from Lean v4.35.0 / Mathlib 56a00585 to the tracker pins (Lean v4.34.1 / Mathlib d13f23b). Upstream notes that the proof has passed machine checks only and that no mathematician has read it through. The Lean text was written by Claude (AI).
